title: Let shelter be personal again
summary: This meets fear when it has made the world feel parentless and exposed. The line answers with startling nearness: Father, Mother, kin, protector.
lifeApplication: When dread starts running ahead of the moment, place a hand on the chest and say the line slowly. Let relationship return before fear makes everything strange.

source.shortMeaning: The Lord shelters the heart as parent, kin, and protector.
source.lifeApplication: When fear rises, let the line restore nearness before the mind runs.
